nodes.summary: Counting lemma: for any family of reals `t` indexed by `G` and any `k`, at most `k` elements `h` have rank count `#{g | t h ≤ t g}` at most `k`.
nodes.title: Counting lemma for rank counts

nodes.summary: Phipson and Smyth (2010); Hemerik and Goeman (2018): if the null law `μ` is invariant under a finite group `G` and `g₁, …, g_B` are drawn independently and uniformly from `G`, independently of the data, then `(1 + #{b | T(g_b • ω) ≥ T(ω)}) / (B + 1)` is a valid p-value under the joint law.
nodes.title: Validity of Monte Carlo permutation p-values

nodes.summary: Lehmann and Romano (2005), §15.2; Hemerik and Goeman (2018): if the law `μ` is invariant under the action of a finite group `G`, the permutation p-value of any measurable statistic is valid.
nodes.title: Validity of permutation p-values

nodes.summary: The Monte Carlo permutation p-value `(1 + #{b | T(g_b • ω) ≥ T(ω)}) / (B + 1)` of the statistic `T` at the data `ω` with the `B` drawn group elements `g`.
nodes.title: Monte Carlo permutation p-value

nodes.summary: The permutation (group-invariance) p-value of the statistic `T` at `ω`: the fraction of group elements `g` with `T (g • ω) ≥ T ω`.
nodes.title: Permutation p-value

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
